_comment: The digestHash every scenario must produce (Bench/README.md, 'Digest format'). First recorded from Unity.SpaceGod's C# Core (Bench.CSharp, US-T23); this repo is C++-only since c965508, so the C++ Core is the reference and these are re-recorded from it whenever a sim change legitimately moves them (last: US-T411, after US-T229: a git bisect over the 87 commits since found 1891497 'Stoppable escapes' (US-T98, an AI hull's spoolable FTL escape, gunners aiming for its engines while it charges) as the first to move them, a deliberate new AI mechanic, not a bug; nothing in US-T296 through US-T413 moved them further, confirmed by running Bench on the commit right before that session and on this commit and getting byte-identical digests both times).
